message.content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "ref": "[R236]",
      "area": "control",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the controls are unreliable and hostile, causing frustration.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Tragically, the experience is largely overcast by an unreliable and borderline hostile control scheme. Because of this, most levels took on a imbalance of spending a moment figure out what to do and minutes trying to make the controls accomplish what should have been a simple task."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R236]",
      "area": "control",
      "claim": "A parent reports that poor controls undermine the otherwise beautiful game.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Beautiful game undermined by poor controls"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R238]",
      "area": "control",
      "claim": "A parent reports that controls could be improved but are not a major issue.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "I also see some people complaining about some of the puzzles/levels being too hard. That’s crazy. UNLESS you like your puzzle games to be entirely unchallenging so you can just go through the motions of doing the puzzles without really thinking. This is totally not a ~hard~ game. You just have to actually think for a minute and use some trial and error sometimes."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R243]",
      "area": "control",
      "claim": "A parent reports that controls are frustrating due to camera angle and lack of visual assistance.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Switching between different bricks, hold to drop and left up operation often conflict with each other. Because of the camera angle and no other visual assistants, it’s really hard to tell where will be the brick be actually dropped."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R260]",
      "area": "control",
      "claim": "A parent reports that controls are fine but could be improved.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "The controls were fine but I think they could be improved."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R272]",
      "area": "control",
      "claim": "A parent reports that controls are not great and a sluggish camera hinders gameplay.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "However, the controls are not great, and a very sluggish camera doesn't really allow you to get a good view of the placement of legos."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R275]",
      "area": "control",
      "claim": "A parent reports that controls are lacking and require full focus to drop pieces.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Unfortunately the controls for changing puzzle pieces are a bit frustrating, as you are required to fully focus on dropping them before picking up a new one."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R233]",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports difficulty progressing past the beginning, indicating potential age or skill barriers.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "How do I pass the beginning? It has been driving me crazy and I really want to know how. It is really annoying."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R273]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game is boring, repetitive, and has easy puzzles.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The puzzles are very easy. Very short. It does have very good graphics, though, but that it the only good thing."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R277]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports being lost within the first 5 minutes due to lack of instructions.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I must be dumb but I have no idea what I’m supposed to do after the 4th sweep.. no help, pointers, nothin... so gonna go ahead and delete."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R278]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is a waste of time due to no instructions.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "No instructions. Waste of time."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R276]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports confusion about the objective, leading to early abandonment.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Super fun game where there’s no instruction and you just try to place four LEGO pieces in diner order that lets you advance, but that never happens."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R244]",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game collects data for ads or third parties.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The game is glitched out. I recorded my screen to show the glitch. Can LEGO let me know where to send the glitched video?"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R250]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game is free to download but may include in-app purchases.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "This is such a fun, beautiful, challenging game that I had to come here and give them 5 stars! It’s absolutely amazing and stunning with beautiful story line. Who ever created this is absolutely genius and I thank you for it! It’s short but fun, expect to beat it within an hour but worth every min of it! 5 stars for sure! Thank you apple/lego"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R245]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game is amazing but wishes it were longer, implying potential for paid content.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Only wish it were longer!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R246]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game is too short, suggesting potential for additional paid content.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "It wasn’t long enough!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R247]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game is rigged, possibly referring to monetization practices.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "rigged"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R258]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game is too short and suggests it should be longer for the price.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The makers of this game should get a lot more money to make a 10x larger game."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R259]",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game tracks location and has poor zoom functionality, indicating data collection concerns.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I can’t even zoom in. Also the time based levels are frustrating since the bricks just float every where but the exact location you what."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R254]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the developer has faced issues with GameCenter synchronization, indicating potential developer record concerns.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "This has continually been something which has stopped me from enjoying a lot of games in Arcade. Can I or can I not move between devices on the same GameCenter account? What’s the point in having this service if the game doesn’t stay the same way on every device."
    }
  ]
}
